hero.title: Choose the right plan to grow your restaurant.
hero.description: All plans include Website, Reservations, QR Ordering, CRM, Reviews and integrated operations. Growth unlocks Revenue AI, AI Visibility and the Partner Network; variable usage is prepaid.

accountState.trialText: You're trying out all of MesaLink's features.
accountState.noPlanText: Choose a plan to keep using the platform.

trialBox.title: Full trial active
trialBox.text: You still have {days} day(s) to try Website, QR Ordering, CRM, Reviews and Marketing before choosing a plan.

upgradeBox.title: Upgrade available
upgradeBox.text: Activate Growth for just +20€/month and unlock automatic Marketing, customer win-back and campaigns for slow days. It keeps the same renewal date, and Stripe calculates the prorated difference.

essentials.description: For restaurants that want to centralize reservations, website, QR Ordering, CRM, reviews and operations in a single system.

growth.description: For restaurants that want to recover revenue, gain visibility in AI search and activate local partners.

credits.title: Balance: {credits} AI credits
credits.description: Every account receives 1,000 emails. After that, 1 AI credit automatically adds 75 emails or 8 WhatsApp messages. Each outgoing WhatsApp message costs about €0.03; incoming messages are free.
credits.success: Payment confirmed. Credits become available as soon as Stripe completes processing.
credits.taxNote: Prices exclude VAT. Applicable tax is calculated by Stripe at checkout. Credits do not expire while the account is active.
credits.freeIncoming: Incoming WhatsApp messages do not use balance.

platformSection.title: A living platform for restaurants.
platformSection.text: MesaLink will keep launching new tools to help restaurants grow, gain visibility and simplify day-to-day operations.

taxBilling.title: Tax invoicing handled outside MesaLink.
taxBilling.text: Tax invoicing is handled externally by a certified software of your choice. This cost is not charged by MesaLink.
taxBilling.note: MesaLink keeps reservations, customers, QR Ordering, website, reviews and marketing connected in the same operation.
